title: The Spire of Ironhollow
author: E. M. Vane
blurb: Silas Fairweather, a thief who steals memories, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
